reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Indiana
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Are eviction cases first heard in magistrates court?
*/

% -----------------------------
% Basic helpers (dates, numbers)
% -----------------------------

% date_geq(Date1, Date2) succeeds if Date1 is on/after Date2.
date_geq(date(Y1,M1,D1), date(Y2,M2,D2)) :-
    (  Y1 > Y2
    ;  Y1 =:= Y2, M1 > M2
    ;  Y1 =:= Y2, M1 =:= M2, D1 >= D2
    ).

% After June 30, 2021 means on/after July 1, 2021.
after_june_30_2021(Date) :-
    date_geq(Date, date(2021,7,1)).

% -----------------------------
% Statute translations (jurisdiction rules)
% -----------------------------

/*
  IN Code  33-28-3-4 (2021) (Circuit courts) and
  IN Code  33-29-2-4 (2021) (Superior courts)

  Both provide (after June 30, 2021) that the small claims docket
  has jurisdiction over:
   (2) Possessory actions between landlord and tenant where
       rent due at filing <= $10,000.
   (3) Emergency possessory actions under IC 32-31-6.
*/

% statute_applies_small_claims_2021(Case) captures the "applies after June 30, 2021" condition.
statute_applies_small_claims_2021(Case) :-
    filed_date(Case, Date),
    after_june_30_2021(Date).

% statute_small_claims_jurisdiction_possessory(Case) captures jurisdiction for possessory actions with rent due <= 10,000.
% Cites: IN Code  33-28-3-4(b)(2) (2021); IN Code  33-29-2-4(b)(2) (2021).
statute_small_claims_jurisdiction_possessory(Case) :-
    statute_applies_small_claims_2021(Case),
    possessory_action_between_landlord_tenant(Case),
    rent_due_at_filing(Case, RentDue),
    number(RentDue),
    RentDue =< 10000.

% statute_small_claims_jurisdiction_emergency_possessory(Case) captures jurisdiction for emergency possessory actions.
% Cites: IN Code  33-28-3-4(b)(3) (2021); IN Code  33-29-2-4(b)(3) (2021).
statute_small_claims_jurisdiction_emergency_possessory(Case) :-
    statute_applies_small_claims_2021(Case),
    emergency_possessory_action_under_ic_32_31_6(Case).

% small_claims_docket_has_jurisdiction(Case) is true if either statutory jurisdiction basis applies.
small_claims_docket_has_jurisdiction(Case) :-
    statute_small_claims_jurisdiction_possessory(Case),
    !.
small_claims_docket_has_jurisdiction(Case) :-
    statute_small_claims_jurisdiction_emergency_possessory(Case).

% -----------------------------
% Scenario (facts from the question)
% -----------------------------

% The question is about an eviction case.
% We model an "eviction case" as a landlord-tenant possessory action.
case(case1).
state(indiana).
focus_year(2021).

% Filed after June 30, 2021 (statutes apply).
filed_date(case1, date(2021,7,15)).

% Eviction/possessory action between landlord and tenant.
possessory_action_between_landlord_tenant(case1).

% Rent due at the time of filing (chosen within the statutory threshold to let the statutes determine forum).
rent_due_at_filing(case1, 1500).

% Not an emergency possessory action in this scenario (no fact asserted).
% emergency_possessory_action_under_ic_32_31_6(case1).  % (intentionally absent)

% scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the factual statement (an eviction case filed in 2021) is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    state(indiana),
    focus_year(2021),
    case(case1),
    possessory_action_between_landlord_tenant(case1).

% -----------------------------
% Reasoning: where the case is first heard
% -----------------------------

% We treat "magistrates court" as a distinct forum label from "small claims docket".
court_type(small_claims_docket).
court_type(magistrates_court).
court_type(other_court).

% first_heard_in(Case, CourtType) derived from jurisdiction in the statutes.
first_heard_in(Case, small_claims_docket) :-
    small_claims_docket_has_jurisdiction(Case),
    !.
first_heard_in(_Case, other_court).

% -----------------------------
% Answer the question
% -----------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    first_heard_in(case1, magistrates_court),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main
% -----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are eviction cases first heard in magistrates court?
